notes: A treasure hunt for hidden chests is Adventure's Scavenger Hunt preset outright — chests are objective collectibles and the hiding places are discovery alcoves. Shape is world-open because the compact pirate island is one contiguous surface found in any order, and the answers put a few minutes of walking between the farthest chests, so nothing needs separate maps. I dropped the preset's tracker-quest board since the author chose an on-screen leaderboard, which is UI rather than geometry, and left the pirate island as theme only rather than adding a water-body the prompt never asked for, which keeps the build on P0.
